messages:
maya: Quick ask for launch exec  we need a single Figma bundle that contains: one 16:9 slide master, three benchmark microtiles (cost / latency / throughput), a routing micro-diagram (SVG), animated GIF hero (600x360, subtle sparkline), and banner ad variants (300x250, 728x90). Deliverables must include EN, JA, PT-BR translations. Can design get a deck + exports within 48h?
oliver: Got it. Do we have canonical numbers for the charts or should design use placeholders?
sophie: If placeholders are used, annotate frames as "sample" and pull final CSV from drive. GIF spec: 3-frame loop, max 2MB, no flashing, include PNG fallback. For banners keep file sizes <150KB.
brand-ops: Brand constraints: logomark min 72px, Redwood Sans for headings, token palette only, primary text contrast 4.5:1. Avoid absolutes like "best"; use "low-latency" / "cost-efficient". Include a footnote frame with test conditions.
translation-bot: Uploaded translations CSV: https://drive.redwood/launch/translations_4512345678.csv (columns: key,en,ja,pt_br). Headline limit 60 chars, subhead 140 chars, CTA 20 chars.
figma-bot: Created file 'Launch / Intl Asset Pack' and branch 'intl-4512345678'  https://www.figma.com/file/xyz123/Launch-Intl-Asset-Pack?node-id=0%3A1
sophie: Export naming scheme I'll use: `launch_v1_{lang}_{asset}_{w}x{h}.png` e.g., `launch_v1_en_slide_1920x1080.png`. Alt-text examples I will attach to each frame: "Line chart comparing cost per 1k tokens; lower is better." and "Diagram: smart routing with hosted -> dedicated -> private fallback."
maya: Please include dark theme alternatives and a short one-pager (CSV-ready) listing export files + alt-text + copy variants for ops ingestion. Also include a legal copy snippet for the hero stat referencing test conditions.
oliver: Timeline: I'll aim to drop first pass frames in the branch within 24h; GIF and banners by 48h. Flagging @brand-ops for sign-off once uploaded.
maya: Perfect  thanks team. If you need placeholders use devbench CSV and mark as representative. Post links here when ready and I'll coordinate legal/brand review. :rocket:
